final: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM g) SELECT g.gender, g.order_count, g.order_count - a.avg_count AS above_avg FROM g, a WHERE g.order_count > a.avg_count
